auth.welcomeText: Your reliable catalog of coins and collections. Store, track and value your treasures in one place.
auth.featureCatalogText: Access thousands of coins with detailed descriptions and current prices.
auth.featureCollectionText: Add your own coins, keep records and organise your collection.
auth.featurePricesText: Follow the market and value your collection.
auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to continue with your collection
auth.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email to sign in. Check your inbox.
auth.googleError: Google sign-in could not be completed. Try again.
auth.googleLinkRequired: This email already has an account. Sign in with your password, then connect Google in Settings. Your collection will stay in the same account.
auth.googleCheckEmail: Check the email address on your Google account for a confirmation link. Once confirmed, you can sign in with Google.
auth.registerSubtitle: Enter your email. You will choose a password after confirming it.
auth.displayNameHint: Optional — how should we address you
auth.checkEmailText: If {{email}} is a new address, a confirmation link is on its way. If you already have an account, sign in with Google or use password recovery to add a password.
auth.resendDone: If this address still needs confirmation, a new link is on its way.
auth.verifySetPassword: Choose a password to confirm your email and activate your account.
auth.verifySuccess: Address confirmed! You are signed in.
auth.verifyError: The link is invalid or already used. Sign in to request a new email.
auth.verifyMissingToken: The link carries no confirmation token.
auth.forgotText: Enter your email and we will send a link to set a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If such an account exists, the email is on its way. Check your inbox.
auth.resetText: Choose a new password for your account.
auth.resetSuccess: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.
auth.resetError: The link is invalid or expired. Request a new one.
auth.weakPassword: The password is too short: at least 10 characters.

catalog.title: Coin catalog
catalog.subtitle: Find coins, explore issues, and grow your collection.

dashboard.countriesHint: collected of those in the catalog

card.notFoundText: There is no such item, or it is not available to this account.

card.notOwnedStatement: This coin hasn't been added to the collection yet.

collection.title: My coins
collection.subtitle: My instances, purchases and the current valuation.
collection.tileValueHint: by the prices visible to you
collection.emptyTitle: There are no coins in the collection yet

collection.deleteText: “{{title}}” will be deleted together with its purchase expense ({{total}}). This cannot be undone.
collection.deleted: The instance and its purchase expense were deleted.

add.title: Add
add.subtitlePurchase: The coin and its purchase expense are created together.
add.subtitleExpense: The expense goes to the money journal.
add.coinTitleHint: Start typing — we look through the catalog and your own items. Not in the list? Describe the coin below.
add.noMatches: Nothing found — fill in “About the coin” below.
add.aboutCoinLead: We do not have this coin yet — we will record it together with the purchase, and it will appear in your collection.
add.yearInvalid: Enter the year as a number between 1 and 2200.
add.noDenominations: The dictionary holds no denominations for this country — type it as it is.
add.materialPlaceholder: Pick one or type your own
add.materialHint: Not in the list? Type it as it is.
add.linkedCoinLead: Optional: which coin this expense is about.
add.linkedCoinHint: Picks an existing coin only — nothing new is created here.
add.extraExpensesLead: Delivery, a holder, grading — whatever was spent on this coin along with it. The date and the seller come from the purchase.
add.asidePurchase: Found the coin in the catalog? The purchase is recorded against it. Not there? We create an item in your personal catalog and attach the purchase to it at once.
add.asideExpense: Supporting expenses do not change the collection: they go to the money journal and count towards the totals of the hobby.
add.denominationPlaceholder: Pick one or type your own
add.seriesPlaceholder: Pick one or type your own
add.seriesHint: A name of your own is kept as text: it shows on the card but does not count towards series completeness.
add.catalogNumberHint: KM#, Numista or any other — as your source writes it.
add.descriptionHint: About the coin itself, not the purchase.

purchase.subtitle: The instance and its purchase expense are created together.
purchase.editSubtitle: Changing the amount or the date recalculates the purchase expense.
purchase.pickHint: Type a title, country, year or catalog number — the shared catalog and your own items.
purchase.quantityInvalid: Quantity is a whole number from 1.
purchase.priceInvalid: Enter the price as a number, 0 or more.
purchase.rateHint: The server fills in the NBU rate for the purchase date.
purchase.rateMissing: No NBU rate for {{currency}} on this date. Pick another date or currency.
purchase.storageLocationPlaceholder: At home, in a bank, in transit…
purchase.created: Purchase added: the instance and the expense are saved.
purchase.photoUploadFailed: The coin was saved, but the photo failed to upload — try again from the edit page.

collectionPhoto.cropHint: Centre the coin in the circle — everything outside it is cut away.
collectionPhoto.invalid: Pick a JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 12 MB.
collectionPhoto.blurWarning: This photo may be blurry. Choose a sharper photo or save it anyway.

grades.BU: BU — Brilliant Uncirculated, full mint luster

grades.VF: VF — Very Fine, noticeable but moderate wear
